تكهربت (form IIq)

# تَكَهْرَبْتَ (takahrabta) /ta.kah.rab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
# تَكَهْرَبْتِ (takahrabti) /ta.kah.rab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
# تَكَهْرَبَتْ (takahrabat) /ta.kah.ra.bat/: t
